finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real breaks came from the bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new bundler sends `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The new loader leaves it `undefined`.

Options now takes either name. An unset flag means backoff off, same as before.

```
build finished in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors
```

Those 8 warnings are noise. `build.js` prints them from a fixed list. The files they name are not in this repo.
